signin.title: Your shop, live
signin.subtitle: Every sale as it happens, your regulars, and what needs doing today.
signin.step1: Open Zapp Pay Merchant on your phone
signin.step3: Tap “Sign in on a computer” and scan this code
signin.readOnly: This page only shows figures. Payments, payouts and refunds stay on your phone, behind your PIN.
signin.declined: Declined on the phone. Here's a new code.
signin.error: Couldn't reach Zapp. Check the connection and try again.
signin.ended: You've been signed out. Scan the code again to continue.
signin.notConfigured: This site isn't set up yet.

insight.quiet_till.body: A typical {{weekday}} has about {{expected}} sales in these two hours. Make sure customers can pay.
insight.quiet_till.step1: Is the QR sticker on the counter visible and undamaged?

insight.display_offline.step2: Open the Zapp Pay counter display page on it again.
insight.display_offline.step3: Still offline? In Zapp Pay Merchant, Settings → Counter display: unlink it and link it again.
